title: AlertShadowReport
description: What comparing the stored condition text with the plan has shown for one alert. Every alert reads every change event, so most compared events are ones both engines reject, and agreeing on those proves nothing: the report therefore counts what was exercised.

matchedByAnEngine.description: Compared events at least one engine said belong to the alert.

matchedBySubjectType.description: The same count, by the type of the entity the event is about.

notComparable.description: Events not compared because the alert's stored text is not what this server's catalog compiles its definition to. Saving the alert makes it comparable.

skipped.description: Events not compared because the comparison had used its time within the tick.

disagreements.description: Compared events about which the engines gave different answers.

latestDisagreements.description: The latest of them, newest last, at most twenty.

conditions.description: Coverage by the name of each filter and trigger the alert uses.
